decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo printer is a core next-generation system close to the established offer, featured on the home page, and the growing firm has slack to keep developing it.
The numbering software module adds serialization capability, which fits the firm's direction toward traceability, and costs little to keep.
The coder for non-absorbent surfaces extends the core inkjet and ink expertise into a steady consumables business, so there is no performance shortfall to trigger search.
The decoding app is cheap, already succeeded an earlier app and supports traceability, though apps are often renamed or replaced, which raises its risk somewhat.
Inline code verification is central to the firm's compliance and traceability strategy and complements its marking systems.
The layout design software supports common operation across the firm's systems and was showcased on the home page, so results appear at or above aspiration.
